name: Dependency-Track-FrontEnd
description: Front end to be used with Dependency-Track API Server Dependency-Track is an intelligent Component Analysis platform that allows organizations to identify and reduce risk in the software supply chain. Dependency-Track takes a unique and highly beneficial approach by leveraging the capabilities of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM). This approach provides capabilities that traditional Software Composition Analysis (SCA) solutions cannot achieve. For more details about Dependency-Track see the projects website at dependencytrack.org Default Login username: admin password: admin
